name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for bathroom leak repair in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for bathroom leak repair in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for bathroom leak repair in the Bay Area, look for professionals with experience in water damage and general contracting. Check their licensing, insurance, and reviews from previous clients. Ask for detailed estimates and inquire about their process for identifying the leak, repairing the damage, and preventing recurrence. A reputable contractor will provide clear communication and a warranty on their work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with water damage experience, proper licensing and insurance. Check reviews, ask for detailed estimates, and inquire about their repair and prevention process.
